name: Sans Barber
lead: A Nottingham barbers with years of experience and the latest tools. Walk in, take a seat, grab a drink, and leave looking fresh and clean.

experience.title: We take pride in what we do
experience.text: Our years of experience have put us in a legendary position in Nottingham. We've worked on all types of hair and styles, and we want you treated well and comfortably while you wait, with snacks and drinks on us.

currency_note: Walk-ins only, no appointments. Last entry 30 minutes before closing.

special.title: The hot towel
special.text: The ultimate way to end your cut with us: a relaxing, sensational experience that softens the beard, opens the pores and leaves your face clean.

reviews: Absolutely amazing job done by sans barber shop! Superb with kids, mine normally hates having his hair cut! And yet they really worked there magic!! Giving him treats and sweets and He stayed still and loved it! Definitely recommend for anyone with kids!!.
I got exactly the haircut I wanted, everytime. The best customer service oriented barber shop in Nottingham.
Great Service and Great Haircuts! Would highly recommend.
I've tried many barbers in Nottingham, but Dan's is by far the best. Been coming years now because the attention to detail and professionalism is such a high level.

audit.title: What sansbarber.co.uk is costing you, and what this fixes.
